definition_en: The mental process of acquiring knowledge through thought and the senses.
example_en: Sleep loss measurably impairs cognition in healthy adults.
example_uz: Uyqusizlik sog'lom kattalarda idrokni sezilarli darajada susaytiradi.

definition_en: To provide evidence that supports a statement or theory.
example_en: A second excavation corroborated the dating of the earlier site.
example_uz: Ikkinchi qazish ishlari avvalgi joyning sanasini tasdiqladi.

definition_en: To reach a conclusion by reasoning from known facts.
example_en: From the ash layers, geologists deduced the eruption's date.
example_uz: Kul qatlamlaridan geologlar otilish sanasini aniqlab xulosa chiqarishdi.

definition_en: A conclusion reached from evidence rather than direct observation.
example_en: The study's inference rests on a small and uneven sample.
example_uz: Tadqiqotning xulosasi kichik va notekis namunaga asoslangan.

definition_en: To suggest something as true so it can be used as the basis for reasoning.
example_en: Early astronomers postulated a perfectly circular orbit.
example_uz: Dastlabki astronomlar mukammal doiraviy orbitani faraz qilib ilgari surishgan.

definition_en: To increase rapidly in number.
example_en: Online courses proliferated once universities closed their campuses.
example_uz: Universitetlar kampuslarini yopgach, onlayn kurslar tez ko'paydi.

definition_en: Concerned with the nature or quality of something rather than its amount.
example_en: The researchers added qualitative interviews to the survey data.
example_uz: Tadqiqotchilar so'rovnoma ma'lumotlariga sifat jihatidan intervyularni qo'shishdi.

definition_en: The set of reasons behind a decision or belief.
example_en: The paper explains the rationale for excluding the outliers.
example_uz: Maqolada chetdagi qiymatlarni chiqarib tashlash asosi tushuntirilgan.

definition_en: Given and received in equal measure by two sides.
example_en: The two species have a reciprocal relationship: each feeds the other.
example_uz: Ikki tur o'zaro munosabatda: har biri ikkinchisini oziqlantiradi.

definition_en: Unwillingness to do something.
example_en: Their reluctance to share raw data slowed the review.
example_uz: Ularning xom ma'lumotlarni bo'lishishni istamasligi ko'rikni sekinlashtirdi.

definition_en: To prove a claim with evidence.
example_en: No fossil evidence substantiates that migration route.
example_uz: Hech qanday qazilma dalil o'sha ko'chish yo'lini asoslamaydi.

definition_en: To confirm that something is accurate or acceptable.
example_en: A second laboratory validated the original measurements.
example_uz: Ikkinchi laboratoriya dastlabki o'lchovlarni tasdiqladi.

definition_en: The state of having more than one possible meaning.
example_en: The ambiguity in the wording led to two different readings.
example_uz: Iboradagi noaniqlik ikki xil talqinga olib keldi.

definition_en: Similar in a way that allows a useful comparison.
example_en: A cell membrane is analogous to a gate that admits some molecules.
example_uz: Hujayra membranasi ba'zi molekulalarni o'tkazadigan darvozaga o'xshash.

definition_en: To provide clear evidence that something is true.
example_en: Layers of sediment attest to centuries of flooding.
example_uz: Cho'kindi qatlamlari asrlar davomidagi toshqinlardan guvohlik beradi.

definition_en: Not harmful; in medicine, not cancerous.
example_en: The growth proved benign and needed no further treatment.
example_uz: O'sma zararsiz bo'lib chiqdi va qo'shimcha davolash talab qilmadi.

definition_en: To adjust an instrument so its measurements are accurate.
example_en: Each sensor is calibrated against a known standard before use.
example_uz: Har bir sensor ishlatishdan oldin ma'lum standart bo'yicha sozlanadi.

definition_en: The stopping of something.
example_en: Recovery began within weeks of the cessation of logging.
example_uz: Tiklanish daraxt kesish to'xtatilganidan bir necha hafta ichida boshlandi.

definition_en: To find a way around a rule or obstacle.
example_en: The design circumvents the need for an external power source.
example_uz: Dizayn tashqi quvvat manbaiga bo'lgan ehtiyojni chetlab o'tadi.

definition_en: The quality of forming a united or well-connected whole.
example_en: Examiners look for cohesion between paragraphs, not just correct grammar.
example_uz: Imtihonchilar faqat to'g'ri grammatikani emas, xatboshilar orasidagi bog'lanishni ham qidiradi.

definition_en: To begin.
example_en: Field work will commence as soon as the rains stop.
example_uz: Dala ishlari yomg'irlar to'xtashi bilanoq boshlanadi.

definition_en: Happening at the same time.
example_en: Two concurrent studies reached opposite conclusions.
example_uz: Bir vaqtda o'tkazilgan ikki tadqiqot qarama-qarshi xulosaga keldi.

definition_en: Depending on something else that may or may not happen.
example_en: Funding is contingent on the pilot study succeeding.
example_uz: Moliyalashtirish sinov tadqiqotining muvaffaqiyatiga bog'liq.

definition_en: Introducing a statement that reverses the one before it.
example_en: Warm years reduce the ice; conversely, cold years rebuild it.
example_uz: Issiq yillar muzni kamaytiradi; aksincha, sovuq yillar uni qayta tiklaydi.

definition_en: To have a mutual relationship in which one changes with the other.
example_en: Income correlates with life expectancy, though it does not explain it.
example_uz: Daromad umr ko'rish davomiyligi bilan o'zaro bog'liq, garchi uni tushuntirmasa ham.

definition_en: To describe or mark the limits of something precisely.
example_en: The report delineates three stages of language acquisition.
example_uz: Hisobotda til o'zlashtirishning uch bosqichi aniq belgilangan.

definition_en: To gradually disappear by spreading out.
example_en: The heat dissipates quickly once the sun sets.
example_uz: Quyosh botishi bilan issiqlik tez tarqalib ketadi.

definition_en: To draw out a response or information from someone.
example_en: Open questions elicit longer answers than yes-no ones.
example_uz: Ochiq savollar ha-yo'q savollaridan ko'ra uzunroq javob oldiradi.

definition_en: To send out light, heat, sound or a substance.
example_en: The mineral emits a faint glow under ultraviolet light.
example_uz: Mineral ultrabinafsha nurda xira yog'du chiqaradi.

definition_en: Lasting for a very short time.
example_en: Desert flowers are ephemeral, blooming only after rain.
example_uz: Cho'l gullari qisqa muddatli — faqat yomg'irdan keyin ochiladi.

definition_en: Growing ever more rapidly in proportion to its current size.
example_en: Early in an outbreak, cases can show exponential growth.
example_uz: Epidemiya boshida holatlar eksponensial o'sishni ko'rsatishi mumkin.

definition_en: Happening at irregular intervals rather than steadily.
example_en: Sporadic rainfall makes the harvest hard to predict.
example_uz: Vaqti-vaqti bilan yog'adigan yomg'ir hosilni bashorat qilishni qiyinlashtiradi.

definition_en: Made up of parts that are all the same kind.
example_en: The sample was too homogeneous to reveal social differences.
example_uz: Namuna ijtimoiy farqlarni ko'rsatish uchun juda bir jinsli edi.

definition_en: Happening in small steps rather than all at once.
example_en: Progress here is incremental, not a single breakthrough.
example_uz: Bu yerdagi taraqqiyot yagona kashfiyot emas, bosqichma-bosqich boradi.

definition_en: Present from birth rather than learned.
example_en: Whether grammar is innate remains a contested question.
example_uz: Grammatika tug'ma yoki yo'qligi hamon bahsli savol bo'lib qolmoqda.

definition_en: Present but not yet active or visible.
example_en: The virus can stay latent in the body for years.
example_uz: Virus tanada yillar davomida yashirin holda qolishi mumkin.

definition_en: To spread through every part of something.
example_en: Salt water permeates the soil and kills the roots.
example_uz: Sho'r suv tuproqqa singib o'tib, ildizlarni nobud qiladi.

definition_en: To be the strongest or most common, or to win in the end.
example_en: Westerly winds prevail along this coast for most of the year.
example_uz: Bu sohilda yilning ko'p qismida g'arbiy shamollar ustun keladi.

definition_en: To measure or express something as a number.
example_en: It is hard to quantify the value of an undisturbed forest.
example_uz: Buzilmagan o'rmonning qiymatini miqdoriy aniqlash qiyin.

definition_en: Not certain or final; open to change.
example_en: These are tentative findings from a single season of data.
example_uz: Bular bir mavsumlik ma'lumotlardan olingan dastlabki natijalar.
